paragraphs.label: Ứng tuyển
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

I am writing to apply for the volunteer helper role at a neighbourhood recycling workshop. I saw your notice at the community centre and would welcome the opportunity to support a useful local activity.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu vị trí và nguồn thông tin.

paragraphs.label: Động lực
paragraphs.text: I am interested in sorting household waste because more recyclable material can be collected separately. I would enjoy helping participants practise sorting common household items. I also understand that residents may stop sorting if collection is unreliable, so clear instructions and patient support are important.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phân loại cần thùng và hướng dẫn rõ, đồng thời hệ thống thu gom phải thực hiện đúng.

paragraphs.label: Kinh nghiệm
paragraphs.text: I have helped organise small activities at my college, including welcoming participants and preparing materials. This taught me to explain simple instructions, keep a list of tasks and ask for help when necessary. I can check that participants have a few clean empty containers and help them find the right place before the session begins.
paragraphs.noteVi: Kinh nghiệm mẫu phù hợp vai trò, không tự nhận chuyên gia.

paragraphs.label: Thời gian và kết
paragraphs.text:
I am available on Saturday at nine in the morning, and I can arrive earlier to help with preparation. I would be happy to attend a short interview or training session if required.

Thank you for taking the time to read my letter. Please let me know if you need any further information. I look forward to your reply.

Yours sincerely,
Minh Nguyen
